entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I need to start a return for a helmet I bought a while back.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you tell me a bit more? What specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's just a preference. The color wasn't quite what I expected when it arrived. The box is still unopened, so it's in perfect condition.

Understood. It's important you're happy with the color, especially for your main safety gear. Let me just pull up your order history... I see the helmet was delivered 57 days ago. One moment while I review our policy.
Okay, I have good news. Our policy allows for returns on standard items for up to 90 days. Since you're at day 57, you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh, that's great. So what's the next step?

I've just approved the return in our system. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Simply print it out, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it at any post office. We'll process your refund as soon as we receive it.

Excellent, thank you for making that easy. Now, since I am going to be buying another helmet from you, and I had this one sitting around for a bit, is there any chance you could provide a small discount code for my next purchase? Say, 15% for the trouble?

I appreciate you choosing VeloFit for your next helmet. While I can't add a discount code on top of a full refund, I can assure you that your new purchase will be covered by our full warranty and satisfaction guarantee. We want to make sure your next choice provides the perfect combination of color and safety.
I understand, but a small credit would ensure I place the order today. How about just free expedited shipping on the replacement?

My system unfortunately doesn't allow for those kinds of concessions on a standard return where a full refund is being provided. The good news is the return shipping for the original item is completely free, and you'll get your full purchase price back to put towards the new one.
Alright, I had to try. Thanks for approving the return. I'll look for that email.
You're very welcome. The email should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
